title: Phenotype Fabric Product Boundaries and Authority Map
description: Machine-readable product boundary and authority map for Phenotype Fabric. Defines what is in scope (in_scope: true) and what is in scope of adjacent products (in_scope: false). Source of truth: spec 013-fabric-program-baseline. Cross-referenced from ecosystem/boundaries.md.

in_scope_specs.title: Unified Product Shell and Workspace Model
in_scope_specs.responsibility: Cross-platform packaged UI, CLI, SDK, installer, discovery, graph canvas, simple workspace controls

in_scope_specs.title: Universal I/O Graph, Seats, and Focus
in_scope_specs.responsibility: Typed ports, graph transactions, input/output leases, HID/MIDI/audio/video/clipboard/file endpoint semantics

in_scope_specs.title: Adaptive Heterogeneous Compute and Data Fabric
in_scope_specs.responsibility: Resource inventory, task/object model, placement, residency, fusion/fission, mobility, predictive prefetch

in_scope_specs.title: Locality-Aware Route Compiler and Transport Plane
in_scope_specs.responsibility: L0-L8 locality tiers, stage elimination, shared-memory/PCIe/LAN/WAN/OOB paths, dynamic replanning

in_scope_specs.title: Real-Time QoS, Admission, and Contention Control
in_scope_specs.responsibility: RT0-Bulk classes, resource reservations, Ableton/gaming protection, adaptive degradation, thermal/power policy

in_scope_specs.title: Seamless Surface and Application Presentation
in_scope_specs.responsibility: Full desktops, virtual monitors, semantic app remoting, native pixel proxies, window graphs, MacBook third-display workflow

in_scope_specs.title: Cross-Platform Continuity, Audio, Clipboard, and Files
in_scope_specs.responsibility: Linux/Windows/macOS endpoint adapters, PipeWire/JACK/CoreAudio/WASAPI, typed clipboard, file send/sync/mount, platform permissions

in_scope_specs.title: Agent-Created Realms and Non-Stealing Surface Publication
in_scope_specs.responsibility: Realm provisioning, enrollment, TTL, surface publication, attention requests, resource budgets, fallback consoles

in_scope_specs.title: Security, Identity, Leases, Audit, and Evidence
in_scope_specs.responsibility: Mutual identity, capability authorization, privileged helper isolation, route leases, evidence bundles, OOB isolation

in_scope_specs.title: Phenotype Ecosystem Integration and Product Boundaries
in_scope_specs.responsibility: AgilePlus, thegent, AGSLAG, Tracera, SessionLedger, ShareCLI, NVMS, labs-compute, event contracts

in_scope_specs.title: Observability, Benchmarking, and Verification
in_scope_specs.responsibility: Measurement boundaries, telemetry, benchmark harness, fault injection, compatibility, evidence

in_scope_specs.title: Packaging, Deployment, Upgrade, and Recovery
in_scope_specs.responsibility: Cross-platform install, signed components, configuration, coordinator topology, updates, rollback, diagnostics, OOB recovery

in_scope_specs.title: Fabric Program Baseline (R0 Foundation)
in_scope_specs.responsibility: Product boundary freeze, identifier normalization, documentation-as-code checks, source-confidence policy, release evidence contract

in_scope_specs.title: Capability Inventory and Topology Probe
in_scope_specs.responsibility: Detect, classify, sign, and publish graph-native capability descriptor: CPU/NUMA/cache, GPU/NPU/codec/display/PCIe, audio/MIDI/input/storage/NIC, link metrics

adjacent_products.responsibility: Governed intent: work packages, plans, evidence contracts, AgilePlus-shaped feature specs. Fabric is governed BY AgilePlus.
Agent dispatch: task routing, scheduling, thegent-mcp. Fabric accepts TaskSpec from thegent.
Economic allocation: who pays for what, cost attribution, capacity bidding. Fabric is unaware of cost.
Evidence graph: DAG, atomic claim/lease, presets, queries. Fabric emits evidence references; Tracera owns the graph.
Time-ordered session log. Fabric emits session events; SessionLedger owns the time index.
Process supervision: FUSE driver, runtime-process, sharing. Fabric routes go through ShareCLI for process lifecycle.
Low-level runtime inventory: resource/process/network discovery. Fabric wraps NVMS for capability inventory (per ADR-0020 provisional).
Remote computation substrates. Fabric can route to labs-compute nodes if reachable.
Source provenance for research claims. Fabric cites research sources via ResearchLedger.
Repo metadata: ownership, status, ADR, worklog, dep graph. This file is referenced by RepoLedger.
Hardware inventory: per-machine inventory of capabilities. Fabric's capability descriptor is a more dynamic version of hwLedger's snapshot.
Push validation, code review, evidence gates. Used for the phenotype-fabric release pipeline.
Fleet operations: signing, packaging, distribution, telemetry collection. Fabric owns product packaging; fleet-ops owns fleet operations.

decision_rules.adding_new_in_scope: Requires an ADR (ADR-0023+) and updates this file plus ecosystem/boundaries.md. PR cannot merge without both updates.
decision_rules.changing_adjacent_interface: Requires coordination with the adjacent product's owner. Cross-repo PR and joint review.
decision_rules.name_resolution: ADR-0020 ('provisional name') is intentionally unresolved. Until resolved, the working name 'phenotype-fabric' is canonical.
